blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea—North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, its state news agency KCNA reported early Saturday. The underwater test-fire of the “super-speed” Zam-2.0 system took place on Thursday “to confirm the successful technical updating” of the weapon, the Korean Central News Agency said. “AI technology was applied to the target detection and the guidance function of the new-type super-speed precisely guided torpedo,” KCNA said.
